name: 2bfit
summary:
This is an easy way to exercise, especially the upper body.  You can focus longer and enjoy moving around when you can see balls to interact with.
After a minute (or 60 seconds) you can feel my shoulders and arms a little bit.  And if you keep you feet in place (don't rotate), you can stretch more.  If you go through a wall, the 2bfit area moves along with you.  This makes it easy to stay in a clear area. Enjoy the burn.
